title: The Knowability of God
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: The knowability of God means that although God is greater than human comprehension, He truly makes Himself known. People cannot discover or master God by their own wisdom, but they can know Him because He reveals Himself.
summary: The knowability of God means that although God is greater than human comprehension, He truly makes Himself known. People cannot discover or master God by their own wisdom, but they can know Him because He reveals Himself.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the fullest revelation of God. Through the Son, believers come to know the Father truly, personally, and savingly.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God is not hidden because He is weak or unknowable. He has made Himself known through creation, conscience, Scripture, and supremely through His Son. What can be known about God is revealed because God Himself has shown it.

Knowing God is not the same as mastering every mystery about Him. The creature never becomes equal to the Creator. Yet God truly reveals His character, works, commands, promises, and saving purpose so His people may trust and worship Him.

Scripture presents knowing God as covenantal, relational, and saving. Eternal life is to know the only true God and Jesus Christ whom He has sent. This knowledge is not merely information; it is life with God through Christ.

The knowability of God protects believers from despair and speculation. God has not left His people guessing in darkness. He has spoken, acted, and drawn near so that His people may know Him truly.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many people think God is either unknowable or fully explainable. Both errors are dangerous. If God cannot be known, faith becomes guesswork. If God can be mastered, worship becomes pride.

This doctrine gives humble confidence. Believers do not know everything about God, but they truly know the God who has revealed Himself in Christ and Scripture.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Seek to know God as He has revealed Himself, not as you imagine Him to be. Read Scripture, look to Christ, pray for understanding, and grow in reverent knowledge that leads to worship, trust, obedience, and love.
